records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Wanted to check whether the onboarding made sense or whether anything got in the way. No action needed if everything's going smoothly.

Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Works
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:9c40980d, email:cfa64ed4). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Pro plan and active subscription suggest some intent, but silence plus three stall reasons makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my last note — no pressure if things are just busy on your end.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
